summary: The manual TSE configuration save can switch tssId/clientId without refreshing tse_stammdaten, so the DSFinV-K tse.csv names the wrong TSS or none.
cost: Two ways it breaks. First case: an admin creates the TSS in the fiskaly dashboard and enters tssId/clientId in the manual form. tse_stammdaten keeps its empty migration default, so every export ships tse.csv with empty TSE_SERIAL, TSE_SIG_ALGO, TSE_PUBLIC_KEY and TSE_ZERTIFIKAT (mandatory fields). Second case: an admin who set up TSS A with the wizard later types TSS B's ID into the form. Signatures now come from B, but tse.csv still holds A's serial, public key and certificate. In an audit the signatures do not verify against the declared TSE. Only saveEinrichtung (wizard and takeover) calls fetchTSEStammdaten; UpdateTSEKonfiguration calls SaveEinrichtung directly (line 62).
fix: As proposed. When conf.IstKonfiguriert(), open a setup client with the entered credentials and call RetrieveTSSStammdaten before writing. Map auth failure to ErrTSESetupZugangsdaten and any other failure to ErrTSEVerbindungFehlgeschlagen, with no write on failure. Then SaveEinrichtung and UpsertTSEStammdaten via fetchTSEStammdaten. Leave the clear path unchanged. Add the error codes to the handler MapError table and the byCode texts in TSEKonfigurationSection. Add a command test: a manual save with a new tssId upserts that TSS's Stammdaten. Keep it under the einrichtung lock.

summary: kassensitzungNr is checked by hand without a zog schema in four handlers, with three different codes (invalid_kassensitzung_nr with or without details, invalid_kassensitzung) and no upper bound. This breaks the AGENTS.md rule that the backend validates with zog.
cost: A body {"kassensitzungNr": 3000000000} passes the check and overflows the int4 parameter in pgx, so the client gets a 500 instead of a 400. Each handler builds its own error shape, unlike every ID that goes through ReadAndValidateBody and an IDSchema bounded at MaxInt32.
fix: Add kasse.KassensitzungNrSchema (GTE 1, LTE MaxInt32) with a schema_grenzen_test row, and use ReadAndValidateBody in the three handlers. Keep GTE(0) for export. Drop unused error-code entries from errorMessages.ts only after grep confirms no remaining use.

summary: The wizard re-implements the backend's TSS takeover rules: which states can be taken over, PIN requirement, einsatzbereit, the DISABLED-only new-setup lock, and verbindungIstSigniertfaehig. The backend shapes none of these; they live in setup.go:157-183,373 and TSEBackend.ts:24.
cost: Two copies of a compliance-relevant state machine on a stringly-typed `state` field. A change in setup.go (new fiskaly state, changed PIN rule) leaves the wizard offering a takeover the backend rejects, or hiding the PIN field the backend then demands (tse_setup_pin_erforderlich).
fix: As proposed: one decision function in application/setup.go shared by UebernimmTSE and CheckTSESetup; DTO flags uebernehmbar, pinErforderlich, einsatzbereit, neuanlageMoeglich, signiertfaehig; frontend deletes its copies. No persisted data touched.

summary: The frontend parses raw backend and relay strings. formatDruckfehler matches substrings of Go error chains produced in windows/relay/main.go:266,346,368. formatDruckauftragReferenz/REFERENZ_PRAEFIX_LABEL parse the `<event-name>:<id>` format built in kassenbeleg_command.go, arbeitsbon_policy.go and station/command.go.
cost: A three-way coupling: relay error text -> backend passthrough -> frontend keyword table. Rewording a relay error, or adding a new Referenz prefix in the backend, silently degrades the admin alarm. The message falls back to 'Druckfehler', or to the raw referenz, and no test fails.
fix: As proposed: DruckfehlerMeldung and ReferenzAnzeige in domain/druckstation with Go table tests; DTO gains fehlerMeldung and referenzAnzeige; delete frontend mappings. Do not change stored druckauftraege rows.

summary: RUECKSTAND_WARN_SEKUNDEN = 60 is a hand-copied mirror of backend tse.NachsigniertSchwelle. Its comment claims the two match. The UI calls it 'Rückstand', yet the backend's RueckstandSchwelle is 2 minutes.
cost: Changing NachsigniertSchwelle in signaturstatus.go desyncs the dashboard, sidebar and Finanzamt warnings without any failing check. The same word 'Rückstand' already means 60 s in the UI and 120 s in the Störungsprotokoll.
fix: Add rueckstandKritisch (rueckstand >= tse.NachsigniertSchwelle) to signaturQueueResponse, keep 60 s behaviour, read it in tseAmpel and SignaturPanel, delete the constant, update Zod schema and fixtures.

summary: erlaubtBonmodus, KATEGORIEN_MIT_BONMODUS/hatBonmodus and the schema superRefine mirror Kategorie.ErlaubtBonmodus/HatBonmodus. domain/druckstation/druckstation.go:43 declares that method 'die eine Quelle dieser Regel'.
cost: Two sources for one rule. A new Bonmodus or station, or loosening pro_stueck, makes the UI offer options the backend's zog rejects, or hide valid ones. Response parsing also re-validates a backend invariant, so a backend change can make get-druckstationen unparseable.
fix: As proposed: bonmodusOptionen in get-druckstationen DTO built from AlleBonmodi filtered by ErlaubtBonmodus; frontend filters by it, drops erlaubtBonmodus, KATEGORIEN_MIT_BONMODUS, hatBonmodus and superRefine. Keep the client-side form validation only if the form needs it, derived from the options.

summary: vereinsdatenErledigt re-derives Betreiber completeness in the frontend; its comment says 'Kein vollständig-Flag im Backend'. The backend gate that matters is betreiber.Validate() in KassensitzungEroeffnen (kassenfuehrung/application/command.go:126).
cost: If domain/betreiber adds or tightens a required field, the Finanzamt checklist shows step 1 as done. Opening the Kasse then still fails with betreiber_nicht_konfiguriert. TSEKonfiguration already sets the right precedent with a backend-computed istKonfiguriert.
fix: get-betreiber response gains istVollstaendig = Validate()==nil (false on not found); add to BetreiberSchema; EinrichtungSection uses it; delete vereinsdatenErledigt; update fixtures.

summary: handleDeactivateAllVariants orchestrates a multi-entity command in the client: one deactivate-variante POST per variant in a loop. There is no backend operation for it.
cost: Not atomic. A network drop or 4xx mid-loop leaves the product half-deactivated during service, and the admin must spot it and retry; the comment at line 106 acknowledges this. It also costs N round trips and N audit log lines for one admin intent.
fix: Add admin/deactivate-varianten {produktId}: ProduktRepo method updating all active variants in one transaction (new sqlc query, make sqlc, never edit dbgen), application command, zog-validated POST handler, ProduktBackend.deaktiviereAlleVarianten, replace the loop. Soft delete semantics unchanged; no schema migration needed.

summary: createdAt/updatedAt are sent and parsed for Tisch, User, Produkt and Variante but never read anywhere in the frontend.
cost: No frontend code reads these fields; the only hits are schemas and fixtures. Every fixture in about 11 test files (admin tables/users/products, service DirektverkaufAbschluss, ZahlungAbschluss, drawerUtils, test/fixtures.ts) must still carry two timestamp lines per object. The backend serialises dead payload on every get-all call. No external consumer (e2e, website, windows, scripts, relay) reads them.
fix: Drop the fields from the Tisch, User, Produkt and Variante schemas and from the backend HTTP DTOs in stammdaten/{tisch,user,produkt}/http. Leave produkt_repo/types.go (it mirrors the frozen migration-09 view). Update all fixtures and Go tests, then run make check.

summary: Three more admin response fields are parsed but never read in the frontend: LiveReportingData/ReportingData.kassensitzungNr, AbrechnungServicekraft.anzahlZahlungen and Kassenidentitaet.angelegtAm.
cost: No property access exists for any of them outside the schemas. Every reporting fixture (KassensitzungPage, AdminDashboardPage, LiveReportingSection, ReportingResults, KassenberichtePage, FinanzamtPage tests) has to fill them, and the schemas suggest the UI depends on them. The anzahlZahlungen in eigeneUebersichtResponse is a different, used field and stays.
fix: Remove the response fields from the schemas and from the backend reporting and fiskal/setup DTOs. Update the Go decoding test structs and the frontend fixtures. Keep the kassensitzungNr request args and eigeneUebersicht's anzahlZahlungen.

summary: Tisch-Stornierung, Direktverkauf-Stornierung and Umbuchung send no client idempotency key, so retrying after a lost response books the storno or move a second time.
cost: Fact: StornierungErteilenSchema, DirektverkaufStornierenSchema and BestellungUmbuchenSchema have no key, and neither do the backend request structs (stornierungErteilenRequest, direktverkaufStornierenRequest, bestellungUmbuchenRequest). The backend checks only the remaining stornierbar/umbuchbar quantity. Scenario: Bestellung with 3 Bier is paid; Serviceleitung stornos 1 as Warenrücknahme; the WLAN drops the response. The toast says 'Stornierung ausführen fehlgeschlagen' and the drawer stays open with the stale selection. The retry succeeds and books a second TSE-signed Warenrücknahme, which shows up as a cash difference at Kassensturz. Umbuchung works the same way: a second unit moves to the target table. Pfandrückgabe-Stornierung already solves this with a client stornierungId (PfandrueckgabenAbschnitt).
fix: Add a per-attempt UUID (renewed when the selection changes, as in PfandrueckgabenAbschnitt.versuch) and backend stornierungId/umbuchungId with 200 on same content and 409 on different content. Derive the multi-event IDs deterministically from the key without changing the event JSON (frozen). If that needs a new event version, decide first. Add integration tests on the pfand_idempotenz pattern.

summary: A Tisch payment without Pfand has no idempotency key, so retrying a partial payment after a lost response books a second Zahlung. The comment claiming state-based idempotency is false for partial quantities.
cost: A position has menge 4 Bier and the guest pays 1. The response is lost in the club WLAN; the helper taps Kassieren again. The backend sees 3 unpaid and books a second zahlung-kassiert with its own TSE-signed Kassenbeleg-V1, while cash came in once. Soll exceeds Ist (Kassendifferenz), another guest's Bier shows as paid, and the journal records a payment that never happened (§ 146 Abs. 1 AO, 'richtig'). Only a Warenrücknahme-Storno can repair it, and that also misstates the event. The Pfand path is protected (pruefeGebuchteRueckgabe), the plain path is not (tischgeschaeft/application/command.go:326).
fix: Add zahlungId z.uuid() to ZahlungKassierenSchema, generated per selection via the existing kassieren Vorgang (schluesselFuer, as in DirektverkaufAbschluss). The backend handler passes it to NewZahlungKassiertEvent in place of uuid.New(). Event JSON stays unchanged. Before ValidatePositionRefs, and again on ErrAlreadyExists/ErrConflict, look up a zahlung-kassiert with that ZahlungID in the tisch stream. Equal positions return nil, otherwise 409. Delete the false comment and reword the D08 parenthetical in place.

summary: A Direktverkauf-Storno has no client stornierungId (the backend generates it with uuid.New), so retrying a partial storno after a lost response books a second direktverkauf-storniert. The Pfand storno already has this protection.
cost: A sale of 3 items has 1 cancelled. The response is lost and the Serviceleitung taps Stornieren again. DirektverkaufStornieren replays OffenePositionen (2 left), accepts the request and writes a second signed Stornobeleg (Kassenbeleg-V1 with negative amount). Only one refund was paid out, so the Soll-Kassenbestand is too low and the journal records a cancellation that did not happen. PfandrueckgabenAbschnitt guards exactly this case with a kept stornierungId; the Direktverkauf path in DirektverkaufPage.tsx:103 does not.
fix: Add stornierungId z.uuid() to DirektverkaufStornierenSchema. Extract the key-per-selection logic from PfandrueckgabenAbschnitt into a shared hook. The backend passes the ID to NewDirektverkaufStorniertEvent. Before the replay check, and on an OCC conflict, search the verkauf stream for that stornierungId. Equal positions return nil, otherwise 409. Event JSON stays unchanged.

summary: A Tisch-Stornierung (stornierung-erteilt / bestellung-korrigiert) has no idempotency key, so retrying a partial storno after a lost response books it twice.
cost: Storno 1 of 4 paid Bier; the response is lost and HistorieStornierungDrawer resubmits. ComputeStornoAufteilung still sees 3 cancellable and writes a second stornierung-erteilt: a TSE-signed Warenrücknahme of 1 Bier that never happened, plus a wrong Soll-Kassenbestand. For unpaid quantities, a second bestellung-korrigiert silently removes an item the guest still owes.
fix: Add stornoId z.uuid() to StornierungErteilenSchema, held per selection via the shared hook in HistorieStornierungDrawer. In the backend, derive event IDs with uuid.NewSHA1(stornoId, index) for korrekturId and stornierungId. Before ComputeStornoAufteilung, check whether the tisch stream already holds the index-0 ID. If it does, return nil when the positions are equal and 409 when they differ. Event JSON stays unchanged.

summary: The frontend recomputes the own-work aggregation that the backend already computes and then discards, which breaks the AGENTS.md rule that the backend filters and aggregates.
cost: kasse.ComputeEigeneArbeitAnTisch computes AnzahlOffen, but the tischState DTO ships only the bool `fuerMichErledigt`. MeinTischCard.countOffenePositionen recounts own positions with `bestellerUserId === AuthSingleton.userId`, and ZahlungTab.tsx:69 partitions the same way. That makes two definitions of 'mine' and ties the UI to the unverified JWT `sub`. If the backend rule changes (e.g. an Umbuchung-Zugang counts for the rebooker), the header says 'Für dich erledigt' while the list still shows 'Meine Positionen'.
fix: As proposed: add anzahlEigeneOffen to the tischState DTO and eigene to each unbezahlte position. Share one domain helper with ComputeEigeneArbeitAnTisch. The frontend reads those fields and stops using AuthSingleton.userId in service code. Update the schemas and tests.

summary: `service/get-aktive-tische` is redundant: it returns the same active tables, in the same order, as `service/get-aktive-tische-mit-favoriten` minus `istFavorit`, and its only consumer is the Umbuchung drawer.
cost: The two SQL queries in sqlc/queries/tische.sql (GetAktiveTische, GetAktiveTischeMitFavoriten) have identical WHERE and ORDER BY clauses. The duplication spans a SQL query, a repo method plus its fake, a query method, a handler, a route, a frontend schema (TischSchema reads names through the form-rule createNameSchema, while the sibling uses z.string()) and a second react-query cache of the same rows. The repo grep finds no consumer outside the frontend.
fix: As proposed: switch the Umbuchung drawer to useAktiveTischeMitFavoriten. Delete the route, handler, query, repo and repotest methods, the SQL and the frontend method and hook. Run make sqlc. Update the tests, including TischHistorie.test and HistorieUmbuchungDrawer.test, which respond to the old endpoint.

summary: service/get-aktive-tische is used only by the Umbuchung drawer's target-table select. It returns a subset of service/get-aktive-tische-mit-favoriten (same id, name, saldoCents, minus istFavorit), which the service pages already load and cache.
cost: Opening Umbuchen fires a second request for data the react-query cache already holds. It also keeps a second endpoint, handler, application query, hook, schema and test fixtures alive. The select also lists targets by id instead of by name.
fix: Add isPending to the useAktiveTischeMitFavoriten return (remove the Omit), use it in HistorieUmbuchungDrawer, and keep the filter of the own table. Delete useAktiveTische, TischBackend.getAktiveTische, TischSchema (keep the Tisch type), the /get-aktive-tische route, handler, Query.GetAktiveTische, the repo method, the interface entry in command.go, test mocks, and the SQL query; run make sqlc. Switch the test fixtures in TischHistorie.test.tsx and HistorieUmbuchungDrawer.test.tsx to the mit-favoriten endpoint.

summary: The template tells operators to run a Tagesabschluss before every price or tax-rate change. The handbuch says the opposite: changes take effect at once, with no Kassenabschluss first (§2.2, §3.11).
cost: Operators file this document with the Finanzamt, so it commits them to a procedure jotti does not need. A Betriebsprüfer who finds a mid-session price change could flag it as breaking the operator's own documented procedure. The rule was removed from the handbuch in the v1.0.0 audit (5ae42cf5); this copy survived.
fix: Delete the last sentence of the Stammdaten paragraph. Optionally replace it with: 'Eine Stammdaten-Änderung wirkt sofort auf künftige Buchungen; ein Tagesabschluss davor ist nicht nötig.'

summary: The template, compliance §4.1 and D01 all say Kassenjournal events are never deleted. Released migration 03_ausgabe_entfernen (shipped in v0.16.0) deleted every ausgabe-bestaetigt:v1 row with the delete trigger switched off. Its comment points to D01 for the reason, but D01 never mentions the deletion.
cost: Installs that ran jotti before v0.16.0 lost journal rows: gaps in kassenjournal.id and, by inference, in the per-subject versions of Tisch streams. Verfahrensdokumentation §8 tells the Prüfer that such gaps reveal tampering. The deletion is documented nowhere a Prüfer or operator would read.
fix: Reword D01 with the same decision and add the sentence 'Migration 03 hat die nicht signierten ausgabe-bestaetigt:v1-Zeilen einmalig aus dem Kassenjournal gelöscht.' Add a short note to the Radierverbot paragraph of verfahrensdokumentation.md and to compliance.md §4.1: one-time exception, non-fiscal status events, installs from before v0.16.0, gaps in id and version come from this migration. Check that these events were never signed before writing 'nicht signiert'. Do not touch the migration.

summary: The handbuch says kassensitzungen holds only z_nr, datum and status, and that Bezeichnung is computed by replay. The table has a bezeichnung column, the Kassensitzung struct has a Bezeichnung field, and every query selects it. language.md also maps Bezeichnung to kassensitzungen.bezeichnung.
cost: Two docs disagree on where Bezeichnung lives. A reader following the handbuch would look for it in event replay rather than in the CRUD row the repo reads.
fix: Change to: 'hält `z_nr`, `datum`, `bezeichnung` und `status` … Alle weiteren KS-Daten (Anfangsbestand, Kassenbewegungen) werden bei Bedarf per In-Memory-Replay der wenigen KS-Events berechnet.'

summary: The handbuch says the frontend release pattern is word-for-word the prod-up check. Since b5f2f25d, prod-up uses parse_semver in scripts/lib.sh: the leading v is optional and only a -/+ suffix is stripped. The frontend RELEASE_MUSTER requires the v and also accepts a . suffix.
cost: The two checks accept different strings: '1.2.3' passes prod-up but not the handshake, and 'v1.2.3.4' the reverse. Anyone keeping them in sync per this sentence is misled.
fix: Delete the clause '; das Muster ist wortgleich mit der Prüfung im Makefile-Target `prod-up`' from handbuch.md:517.

summary: D02 says reporting.Breakdowns carries only AbrechnungProServicekraft. The struct now also carries PfandProServicekraft (added in the Pfand work).
cost: The binding decision line names a code fact that is false, so the D02 rationale reads as stale.
fix: Reword D02 with the same decision: 'Das Reporting kennt keinen Umsatz-Breakdown je Tisch; `reporting.Breakdowns` schlüsselt nur je Servicekraft auf.' Keep the rest of the line.

summary: language.md says every reporting type exists as a Zod schema with a derived TS type in frontend/src/admin/reporting/types.ts. Since 3c29a40d, most derived types are gone: ServicekraftRef, AbrechnungServicekraft, VarianteStatistik, Summary, StornierungPosition and others are schemas only.
cost: Developers looking up the TS name for a glossary term find nothing to import.
fix: Change to: 'Jeder Typ existiert als Go-Struct (`domain/reporting/`) und als Zod-Schema `<Typ>Schema` in `frontend/src/admin/reporting/types.ts`; einen abgeleiteten TS-Typ exportiert die Datei nur, wo ein Import ihn braucht.' Keep the ProduktStatistikZeile and Breakdowns exceptions.

summary: §6.1 says the domain layer has no JSON access. backend/domain/kasse decodes event JSON in ApplyEvent, FiskalischeProjektion and historie, and encodes it in the event constructors.
cost: The layering rule as written fails against core domain code. A reviewer enforcing it would flag or move correct code.
fix: Change to: 'Kein DB- oder HTTP-Zugriff; JSON nur zum Kodieren und Dekodieren der Event-Data-Structs. Keine `json`-Tags (Ausnahme: Event-Data-Structs).'

summary: The step 'Version-Bump auf 1.0.0 (Image-Tags/JOTTI_VERSION, VERSION für den Windows-Build, ldflags-Version)' has nothing to bump: release.yml takes the version from the pushed tag.
cost: Fact: release.yml 'Version bestimmen' sets version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME}. It passes that to the image build args, the image tags, the sed on docker-compose.release.yml and `make release-windows VERSION=`. No file in the repo holds the release version, and the plan itself says package.json is not read. An operator following the step either hunts for files that do not exist or commits a spurious change after CI went green. That forces a new CI run, and `make prod-release` refuses to tag until it passes. 'Betroffene Dateien' also lists `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, which no step edits.
fix: Replace the bump step with: make prod-release VERSION=1.0.0 sets and pushes tag v1.0.0, and release.yml reads the version from the tag. Drop ci.yml from Betroffene Dateien.

summary: Manual QA has no step for the two new hardware-only risks in [1.0.0]: PC437 umlauts on a real (Epson) printer, and the Pfandbeleg/Stornobeleg layout with negative amounts. Block D's external DSFinV-K check also omits the new GV_TYP Pfand and PfandRueckzahlung rows.
cost: The PC437 codepage fix (a578735e) only proves itself on physical hardware. The formatter tests pin bytes, not what the printer's firmware renders. The Pfandbeleg is a new receipt type. 'Druckbild insgesamt sichtprüfen' does not name it, so a QA pass can skip it. In Block D, IDEA or the fiskaly tooling would check an export with no Pfand rows unless the session is told to include them. The new GV_TYPs would then ship without the external cross-check the block exists for.
fix: Add the two Block A checkboxes and the Block D sentence as proposed.

summary: The Frontend section puts the Positionskommentar state in the Abschluss hooks, but since 3e475214 the Bestellkommentar lives in the page-level `useVorgang` so it survives a remount.
cost: Fact: useVorgang (frontend/src/hooks/use-vorgang.ts) holds the Kommentar, the vorgangId and the retry key above the Radix tabs. TablePage and DirektverkaufPage hand them down, and BestellungAbschluss and KassierAbschluss no longer keep local Kommentar state. A Positionskommentar map built as the PRD says (in the Abschluss) is lost on a tab switch or a closed drawer. A retry then sends different content, which reintroduces the bug f69ec238/3e475214 fixed. The test references also point at BestellungAbschluss.test.tsx, but the Kommentar reset tests moved to use-vorgang.test.ts.
fix: Rewrite the PRD Frontend state lines so useVorgang holds the Positionskommentare keyed by Variante, with the drop-at-zero and clear-on-empty rules. Change the last line to say the state lives in useVorgang. Cite use-vorgang.test.ts in Testing.

summary: The PRD keeps a 30-line 'Rückfall B: SQLite-Linie' that 'gilt nur, wenn der Owner bei SQLite bleibt'. Line 63 says the owner decision names SQLite, while lines 16 and 271 and the backlog say embedded Postgres is decided.
cost: The PRD contradicts itself on the one settled decision. A reader cannot tell whether SQLite is still live, and 'Offene Entscheidungen' lists the settled DB choice as item 1. The dead section also carries a stale fact: it says '122 Postgres-Abfragen', and backend/sqlc/queries now has 126. That breaks the current-state rule with no reader benefit.
fix: Delete the Rückfall B section and its test lines 237-238. Drop line 22 and line 72. Reword line 63 to 'Gewählt ist A; der Owner hat eingebettetes Postgres entschieden.' Remove the settled DB item from Offene Entscheidungen and renumber.

summary: The Stationsmodell PRD still describes #146 as future work and pins its migration to 'nach Migration 10', but #146 shipped and migrations 11-14 (Pfand) have landed.
cost: Fact: 82f76ac0 removed the beep and bca2d63a added kein_bon, and database/migrations runs to 14, with 15 reserved by the programme. Line 15 says '#146 baut getrennt' and line 143 says 'Er wird getrennt gebaut'. Line 77 says 'nächste freie Nummer nach Migration 10'. All three are false now. An implementer reading line 77 literally would pick 11, which collides with 11_pfandrueckgabe.
fix: Line 15: state that #146 built the beep removal and the Kein-Bon mode. Line 77: 'Eine additive Migration mit der nächsten freien Nummer, in einer Transaktion:'. Delete the bullet on line 143.

summary: The public release text heads its table 'Enthaltene Laufzeit-Versionen', but Node 24 and pnpm only build the static app in a builder stage and ship in no image.
cost: Fact: reverse-proxy/Dockerfile uses node:24-alpine only in the app-builder and website-builder stages, and the final stage is caddy:2.11.7. Under D18 no Node runtime exists. The GitHub release would tell operators and security reviewers that a Node runtime is included, which is false.
fix: Rename the heading to 'Enthaltene Versionen' and add a Rolle column (Laufzeit or Build). Update the line 120 wording to 'Build- und Laufzeit-Versionen'.

summary: The FAQ tells clubs to cancel (stornieren) volunteers' consumption, which records goods that were handed out as never sold.
cost: Stornieren unpaid positions emits bestellung-korrigiert:v1, a correction asserting an erroneous order. Goods that were really handed out vanish from the records. § 146a Abs. 1 Satz 1 AO requires a 'richtig' record, and § 379 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 AO fines an untrue record with up to 25.000 EUR (Abs. 6). Inference: a Prüfer reads a run of cancellations on the Helfer tables as suppressed revenue.
fix: Rewrite: helper consumption runs over its own table and is kassiert. Stornieren only for real mis-bookings. For free meals the club agrees handling with the Steuerberater. Owner decision on a dedicated free-consumption recording stays open; do not build it.

summary: The table gives Leitungswasser, Kuhmilch, Milchmixgetränke and Smoothies 7 % without saying that this applies only to take-away delivery.
cost: § 12 Abs. 2 Nr. 15 UStG grants 7 % to restaurant and catering services 'mit Ausnahme der Abgabe von Getränken'. At a Festzelt with tables, milk, milk drinks and water served for on-site consumption are beverages and therefore 19 %. 7 % applies only to a Lieferung under § 12 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 with Anlage 2 Nr. 4/34/35. A club that sets milk drinks to 7 % following this table under-declares VAT. The rows also contradict §1.2 ('19 % unabhängig von der Verzehrsituation').
fix: Leitungswasser, Kuhmilch, Milchmixgetränke: 'vor Ort 19 % (§ 12 Abs. 2 Nr. 15 UStG, Ausnahme Getränke); 7 % nur als Lieferung zum Mitnehmen'. Smoothies row: mark 'Einordnung unklar, Steuerberater fragen', no firm 7 %.

summary: No retention table or guide tells the club to keep the TSE export (TAR from fiskaly), which statute and AEAO require.
cost: § 146a Abs. 1 Satz 4 AO requires the TSE records to stay available for Nachschau and Außenprüfung. AEAO 1.13.1 requires the secured data to be handed over for verification; 1.15.2 requires them in TAR form with all log messages. jotti stores signatures, not TAR log messages. Compliance §4.3 says no extra raw export is needed. Once the club ends its fiskaly contract or decommissions the TSS, the TSE logs are lost before the 10 years are up.
fix: Drop the 'Roh-Exportformat nicht nötig' clause. Add a TSE-Export (TAR, fiskaly export) row to compliance 4.3 and VD 7 with 10 years, to be taken before TSS decommission or contract end. Add the step to leitfaden/datenaufbewahrung.md and checkliste.md decommissioning. No code.

summary: Re-exporting an old Kassensitzung uses today's master data, not the data in force when the session was recorded: Betreiber, TSE master data, table names and software version.
cost: snapshot() reads GetBetreiber, GetTSEStammdaten, GetAlleTischNamen and e.Version at export time. Example: the club switches TSS after a festival, then a Prüfer asks for an export (§ 147 Abs. 6 AO). tse.csv lists the new TSE's serial and public key next to the old signatures, so verification fails. A renamed table rewrites ABRECHNUNGSKREIS. KASSE_SW_VERSION shows the exporting build. That makes VD §8 'Version im DSFinV-K-Export hinterlegt' false. VD line 154 prescribes a Tagesabschluss before price changes, but prices are already frozen in events, so the rule protects nothing.
fix: Docs only: state the export archived right after each day is authoritative; export and archive all sessions before changing Betreiber data, table names or TSE. Replace the VD line 154 sentence with this rule and fix VD 8 version claim. Code freezing is an owner item, not done now.

summary: Without a Befreiung every payment needs a printed receipt, but jotti prints only on request and no guide tells staff to tap print after each payment.
cost: AEAO 2.5.8: offering the receipt is enough only 'wenn zuvor der Beleg erstellt und ausgedruckt wurde'. AEAO 2.5.7: the receipt must follow the transaction immediately. The guide says 'jotti muss für jeden Verkauf einen Beleg erstellen'. That reads as automatic, but the only path is 'Kassenbeleg drucken' in the table or Direktverkauf history. A club without a Befreiung that follows the guides gives out no receipts, which breaches § 146a Abs. 2 Satz 1 AO.
fix: Rewrite the bullet: without Befreiung staff tap 'Kassenbeleg drucken' after each Kassieren and Direktverkauf and offer the receipt. Add the step to leitfaden/veranstaltungstag.md under 'Während des Fests'. No auto-print feature.

summary: The guides have clubs practise in TEST and then switch the same instance to LIVE, so practice sales stay forever in the append-only journal as real business transactions.
cost: The checklist says 'TSE in TEST einmal komplett durchgespielt', then LIVE on the same installation. jotti has no guard and no training mode. Practice Kassensitzungen keep Z_NR, revenue and TEST signatures under the serial number reported to ELSTER, and they appear in every export. A Betriebsprüfung finds revenue that never happened. The DSFinV-K provides AVTraining for practice bookings.
fix: In tse-einrichten.md and checkliste.md: practise only on a separate installation; the installation going LIVE holds no practice Kassensitzung. Docs only; no LIVE guard.

summary: The VD claims usernames are never reassigned, but UpdateDetails lets an admin rename a user and give the freed username to someone else.
cost: backend/domain/user/user.go UpdateDetails sets u.Username freely, and EditUserDialog offers the field. The unique index only blocks two users holding a name at the same time. Example: rename 'annak' to 'anna', then create a new 'annak'. Old journal rows frozen as 'annak' now point to the wrong person on the operator list. users.name can also be overwritten, so the username-to-person mapping keeps no history. The VD statement a Prüfer receives is false.
fix: Docs only: delete the 'werden nie neu vergeben' sentence in VD line 130 and name BEDIENER_ID as the only stable mapping; note usernames can be renamed. Do not remove the rename capability.

summary: §7.5 says the AEAO 'stellt klar' that the phones need no reporting, but that classification is jotti's own inference and AEAO 1.16.2.4 points the other way.
cost: AEAO 2.6 exempts only connected systems 'ohne Kassenfunktion'. AEAO 1.2 defines Kassenfunktion as serving to record cash payments, and staff collect cash on the phones. AEAO 1.16.2.4 says that in Verbundsysteme with one TSE 'jedes einzelne verwendete Gerät' must be reported. The VD hands Prüfern this unconditional statement. A club that reports wrongly must correct its report (AEAO 1.16.3.1).
fix: Recast 7.5 and 2.2 as jotti's Einordnung with reasoning, cite AEAO 1.16.2.4 as counter-provision, advise clarifying with Finanzamt or Steuerberater, and align the VD 2 sentence.

summary: The FAQ tells clubs 'Ihr müsst nichts weiter tun' during a TSE outage, but AEAO 1.14.4 obliges them to remove the cause without delay.
cost: AEAO 1.14.3 tolerates continued operation only 'bis zur Beseitigung des Ausfallgrundes'. Under 1.14.4 the operator must fix the cause without delay. Expired fiskaly credentials, a disabled TSS or a dead uplink never heal by themselves. A club that obeys the FAQ runs whole festivals unsigned.
fix: Replace the sentence: short outages heal automatically; if the warning under 'Finanzamt & TSE' persists, fix the cause without delay (internet, fiskaly status, credentials).

summary: The VD claims to serve as the Herstellerdokumentation under BSI TR-03153-1 Kap. 3.9.3, but §4 gives only a target latency, not the delay for transactions signed at the same time.
cost: TR-03153-1 3.9.3 requires stating 'Durchführungszeiten und mögliche Verzögerungen ... in Abhängigkeit gleichzeitig zu bearbeitender Absicherungen'. The measured values are in handbuch §3.13 (0.3 s per signature, serial, burst of 24 at p95 about 7 s). VD §4 says only 'p95 unter fünf Sekunden (angestrebt)', which the burst measurement exceeds.
fix: Add one sentence to VD 4: measured about 0,3 s per signature, serial; n concurrent transactions wait up to n times 0,3 s (burst of 24: p95 about 7 s end to end).
